situations.title: 상부 vs 하부 출혈 문진
situations.tagline: I threw up something dark and I'm scared it might be blood.
situations.brief: 토혈·흑색변·혈변 여부와 발현 시점을 물어 상·하부 출혈을 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Did you vomit any blood or something that looked like coffee grounds?
Have your stools been black and tarry, or bright red?
When did you first notice this?

situations.title: 활력·기립성 저혈압
situations.tagline: Every time I stand up I feel dizzy and almost fell earlier.
situations.brief: 기립성 활력징후와 어지럼·실신 여부를 사정해 혈량 손실을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you feel dizzy or lightheaded when you stand up?
Have you fainted or nearly passed out?
I'm going to check your blood pressure lying down and standing up.

situations.title: NSAID·항응고제 복용력
situations.tagline: I take blood thinners and pain pills for my joints almost every day.
situations.brief: NSAID·항응고제 복용력을 상세히 청취해 출혈 위험을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Which blood thinner do you take, and when was your last dose?
How often do you take pain relievers like ibuprofen?
Do you take any aspirin regularly?

situations.title: 흑색변 주소 노인
situations.tagline: My stools have been black and sticky for a couple of days.
situations.brief: 노인의 흑색변 색·양상과 지속기간을 사정하고 빈혈 증상을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: How many days have your stools looked black?
Have you felt more tired or short of breath than usual?
Have you had any belly pain along with this?

situations.title: 대량 정맥로 확보 설명
situations.tagline: Why do I need two big needles? That looks painful.
situations.brief: 두 개의 큰 게이지 정맥로와 수액의 목적을 이해하기 쉽게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We need two large IVs in case you need fluids or blood quickly.
You may feel a pinch, but it will be over fast.
This helps us treat you as safely and quickly as possible.

situations.title: 정맥류 출혈(간경변)
situations.tagline: I have liver problems and I just vomited a lot of blood.
situations.brief: 음주·간질환력을 사정하고 옥트레오타이드·내시경 준비를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you have a history of liver disease or cirrhosis?
How much blood did you vomit, and when?
We'll start a medicine to reduce the bleeding and prepare for an endoscopy.

situations.title: 소화성 궤양 토혈
situations.tagline: I vomited something that looked like dark coffee grounds.
situations.brief: 커피찌꺼기 양상 토혈을 사정하고 PPI·내시경 계획을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: The coffee-ground appearance suggests bleeding in your stomach.
Have you had heartburn or ulcer problems before?
We'll start an IV acid-reducing medicine and plan for an endoscopy.

situations.title: 하부 GI 대량 혈변
situations.tagline: I keep passing a lot of bright red blood from below.
situations.brief: 선혈변의 양·빈도를 사정하고 대장내시경·정밀검사를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: How many times have you passed blood, and how much each time?
Is the blood bright red or mixed in with the stool?
You'll likely need a colonoscopy to find the source.

situations.title: 와파린 과다 출혈
situations.tagline: My INR was high last week and now I'm bleeding.
situations.brief: 와파린 복용력과 INR을 확인하고 비타민K·PCC 역전을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you last have your INR checked?
How much warfarin do you take each day?
We'll give medicine to reverse the blood thinner and stop the bleeding.

situations.title: 수혈 동의·부작용 설명
situations.tagline: Is getting blood safe? What if I have a reaction?
situations.brief: 수혈의 목적·동의와 수혈 반응 관찰 방법을 이해하기 쉽게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: A transfusion replaces the blood you've lost to keep you safe.
Tell me right away if you feel chills, itching, or trouble breathing.
We'll watch you closely during the transfusion.
goals: 수혈 반응 관찰과 신고 방법을 안내한다

situations.title: Mallory-Weiss(반복 구토 후)
situations.tagline: I was vomiting a lot from drinking, and then I saw blood.
situations.brief: 반복 구토 후 발생한 출혈의 경위를 청취하고 음주·구토력을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Did the vomiting come before you noticed the blood?
How many times had you vomited beforehand?
Have you been drinking alcohol recently?
goals: 반복 구토 후 출혈의 순서를 청취한다

situations.title: 출혈+빈혈 실신
situations.tagline: I've been bleeding and I fainted when I got up to the bathroom.
situations.brief: 실신 경위와 빈혈 증상을 사정하고 재실신·낙상 예방을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you feel dizzy or weak when you sit up?
Please call us before getting out of bed.
We're keeping the bed low and the rails up to prevent a fall.

situations.title: 여호와의증인 수혈 거부
situations.tagline: I need you to know I cannot accept a blood transfusion.
situations.brief: 환자의 신념을 존중하며 수혈 거부를 확인하고 대체 치료를 논의하세요.
keyPhrases: I respect your decision and want to understand your wishes fully.
There are other treatments we can use to support you.
Let's document your preferences clearly with the team.
goals: 환자의 신념과 거부 의사를 존중해 확인한다

situations.title: 재출혈 이력 통합
situations.tagline: This has happened before — I had a scope done a few years ago.
situations.brief: 과거 내시경·시술력을 통합해 재출혈 위험과 병력을 정리하세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me about the endoscopy you had before.
Do you know what was found or treated last time?
Has this type of bleeding happened more than once?

situations.title: 항혈소판제 심장환자 출혈
situations.tagline: I take my heart medicine so I don't get a clot — should I stop it now?
situations.brief: 항혈소판제 지속·중단의 딜레마를 사정하고 심장·소화기 협진을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Which heart medicines are you taking, like aspirin or clopidogrel?
Have you had a stent or heart procedure recently?
The team will weigh your bleeding against your clot risk carefully.

situations.title: 출혈성 쇼크 인지
situations.tagline: My heart is racing and I feel cold and clammy all over.
situations.brief: 빈맥에서 저혈압으로 진행하는 쇼크를 인지하고 대량수혈을 가동하세요.
keyPhrases: Your heart rate is high and your pressure is dropping — we're acting now.
We're giving fluids and blood right away.
Stay with me while the team gets everything ready.

situations.title: 정맥류 대량 토혈 기도위험
situations.tagline: I can't stop bringing up blood and I'm choking on it.
situations.brief: 대량 토혈의 흡인 위험을 인지하고 기도 보호와 SB튜브 준비를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: We're turning you on your side to protect your airway.
Suction is ready to keep your airway clear.
We may need a special tube to control the bleeding.

situations.title: 응고병증 동반 출혈
situations.tagline: The bleeding won't stop and I have a clotting problem.
situations.brief: 응고병증을 인지하고 혈소판·FFP 투여를 SBAR로 보고·조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you have a known bleeding or clotting disorder?
We're ordering platelets and plasma to help you clot.
I'm giving the team an SBAR update on your labs now.

situations.title: 내시경 중 급속악화
situations.tagline: I feel really faint — something doesn't feel right during this.
situations.brief: 시술 중 활력징후 붕괴를 인지하고 즉시 중단·소생 팀을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Your vitals are dropping, so we're pausing the procedure.
We're giving you fluids and calling for extra help.
Stay with me — we're right here with you.
goals: 시술 중 활력 붕괴를 조기에 인지한다

situations.title: 하부출혈 지속 색전술 이송
situations.tagline: They said I need a special procedure to block the bleeding vessel.
situations.brief: 지속되는 하부 출혈에서 IR 색전술 필요성과 이송 인계를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The bleeding hasn't stopped, so we're sending you to a specialist.
They'll block the bleeding vessel through a small catheter.
I'll hand off all your information to the next team.

situations.title: 재출혈 급변 야간 SBAR
situations.tagline: The bleeding started up again and looks darker than before.
situations.brief: 야간 재출혈 시 색조·활력 추이를 파악해 SBAR로 당직에 신속 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: How does the bleeding compare to earlier tonight?
Your vital signs have changed, so I'm calling the doctor.
I'll report your situation, background, and vitals clearly.
